paragraphs: ### Welcome to Midjourney, your portal to transforming text into amazing images and videos! If you're ready to unleash your creativity, this guide is your first step to crafting stunning creations and exploring endless possibilities.
Image 1: getting-started-header.png
Subscribing to Midjourney[](http://docs.midjourney.com/docs/quick-start#h_01JHRHRGGEB9WPRYSR22DGBDPQ)
Before you dive into creating your first masterpiece, you'll need to subscribe to one of our plans. Here's how you can get started:
* Log in to midjourney.com: Logging In & Connecting Accounts
* Select a plan: Comparing Midjourney Plans
* Subscribe: How to Subscribe
Making Your First Image[](http://docs.midjourney.com/docs/quick-start#h_01JHRHZ33ZJY8AFCBXNRTCM58G)
**Video tutorial:** Watch this quick video tutorial on making your first image below.
1. **Visit your Create page:** Go to the Create page on midjourney.com. This is where your images come to life, and you can see them appear in real-time.
2. **Use the Imagine bar:** At the top of the page, you'll see the Imagine bar. Here, type what you'd like to see—this is your prompt.
Image 2: imagine-prompt-bar.png
3. **Generate your images:** After pressing Enter or the send button if you're using a mobile device, Midjourney creates a set of four images. Watch as your images take form.
4. **Congratulations!** Once it reaches 100%, you're done! You've created your first Midjourney images.
Image 3: create-feed.png
Writing and crafting prompts can be an art in and of itself. To learn more, check out our Prompt Basics and Art of Prompting articles.
Personalize Midjourney[](http://docs.midjourney.com/docs/quick-start#h_01JXWRWH90H7JYCZA5V6DJSPG4)
Midjourney is even better with Personalization. Create moodboards and custom Personalization profiles that will help Midjourney generate images that uniquely match your individual style!
Image 4: personalize-page.png
Continue Working on Your Images[](http://docs.midjourney.com/docs/quick-start#h_01JHRKF58HPFKJNBRZ02WVBX42)
The creativity doesn't stop here! Learn how to enhance and refine your creations using upscalers, variations, zoom out, pan, Editor, and more in our Modifying Your Creations article.
Image 5: modify-images.png
Turn Images into Videos[](http://docs.midjourney.com/docs/quick-start#h_01JY2288KSWV9PT71NTT66WR3H)
Make your images come alive by transforming them into videos! Learn how to animate both your Midjourney creations and your own images on our Video article.
Image 6: video-header-new.gif
Customizing Your Settings[](http://docs.midjourney.com/docs/quick-start#h_01JKEVFKEBJ205FYSNJ6NQAKJF)
You can change your default generation settings at any time by clicking on the settings icon Image 7: settings-icon.svg in the Imagine bar.
Image 8: web-settings.png

For more information on each setting, check out these articles: Aspect Ratio (image size), Raw, Version, Draft Mode, Stylize, Weird, Variety, GPU Speed, Stealth, Video Resolution, and Video Batch Size.
Using Images in Your Prompts[](http://docs.midjourney.com/docs/quick-start#h_01JHRKHAQXQMGKMVMAA0J26977)
Did you know that you can also provide Midjourney with images—not just text—to guide your creations?
* Starting Frame lets you create a video from your image.
* Image Prompts let you influence content, composition, style, and colors.
* Style References help you match the look and feel of another image.
* Omni References help you use the same character or object in multiple images.
**Video tutorial:** Watch this quick video tutorial on using images below.
For more information about all the tools and features available on your Create page, check out our Creating on Web article.
Organizing Your Creations[](http://docs.midjourney.com/docs/quick-start#h_01JKES4NVJ2KRRW94FDK7WJ5R6)

Your Organize page offers a clear view of all your Midjourney creations. Here, you can download, sort, and filter your creations. You can also organize them into folders easily. For more tips and tricks, check out our Organizing Your Creations article.
Image 9: organize-feed.png
Community Guidelines[](http://docs.midjourney.com/docs/quick-start#h_01JHRJMGBBFRR57YDAQ9D315V7)
To ensure a safe and happy creative environment, stay informed about our Community Guidelines.
Sharing & Support[](http://docs.midjourney.com/docs/quick-start#h_01JHRJHKVVKC61KX5YDMXCRFPY)
Feel like sharing your works of art? Connect with our community and seek guidance from fellow Midjourney enthusiasts or our helpers in our Discord server.
If you need help with your account or subscription, you can browse helpful billing articles or contact our billing team.

paragraphs: We're a lab of 60 people known for building the most beautiful AI models in the world.
We believe that we are all midjourney: that we have a rich past behind us and an unimaginable future ahead — and the question we want to most help answer is: what do we want to become?
Over the coming months, we’re unveiling a wide range of ambitious projects under the themes of imagination, coordination, reflection, beauty, and human flourishing.

We hope our work will help tell stories of a humane future that we all want to be a part of, and convince you that we aren’t at the end of time, or the beginning, but that we are all midjourney in a vast and great adventure.
We're a lean, self-funded, distributed team and we're always hiring.
Help us build and explore new infrastructure to amplify the human spirit.Learn more.
